headline: WhiteWater reviews Sutton schools' water wells, wastewater tank, and permit extension.
summary: WhiteWater's managers said the district's two drinking water wells and 15,000 gallon storage tank would supply about two days of use if a well failed. They said the wastewater tank, installed in 1998, is near the end of its expected life, and that replacing it would cost multi-million dollars. The committee also approved the Strategic Plan for 2026 to 2032, 5-0.
decisions: Approved the Strategic Plan for 2026 to 2032, 5-0.
discussion: Water and wastewater review: WhiteWater's water and wastewater managers said a new well could cost $60,000 to $100,000, and that the wastewater tank's replacement would cost multi-million dollars. Members asked about backup water, the irrigation well as a possible third well, and how the wells are monitored.

Out-of-district tuition: A budget subcommittee report described out-of-district costs as rising 52 to 54% next year. The report tied the increase to tuition rate increases, lower circuit breaker funding, and new student placements.

Middle school attendance: The middle school update reported an accountability rating of 69 and said attendance remains an area of concern. Members asked about how absences are reported and whether incentives or consequences could help.

Library policy review: Members asked how library materials are selected, how the three-year waiting period for challenges was set, and what safeguards exist. The policy subcommittee will meet Tuesday the 17th at 8:30.

decision_evidence.quote: I move to approve the consent agenda as presented. ... Rea-Erickson, aye. Passes 4-0.
I move to approve the Strategic Plan for 2026 to 2032 as presented. ... Great, motion passed, 5-0.
